description: Class representing animation timeline for a slide.

AddInteractiveSequence.description: Creates an interactive animation sequence triggered by clicking on a specified object.

params.description: The drawing object that triggers the sequence when clicked.
params.name: drawing

returns.description: The interactive animation sequence or null if creation failed.

GetAllEffects.description: Returns all animation effects for the slide.

GetClassType.description: Returns the type of the ApiTimeLine class.

GetInteractiveSequences.description: Returns all interactive animation sequences for the slide.

GetMainSequence.description: Returns the main animation sequence for the slide.
